language_adapters.scope: Importable .rpr module metadata; native operation dispatch is not yet bound to source-level calls.
Shared C ABI registry enumeration, lookup, signature validation and public registry statistics.
The shared C ABI can be consumed by compatible hosts; dedicated language SDKs and operation handlers are not shipped.

public_statistics.source: Computed by reaper_framework_registry_stats() from the native registry.
public_statistics.privacy: Registry metadata only; no user telemetry or runtime activity is collected.
